description: Craig's hooks. Inject Craig's instructions: CLAUDE.md (unless already loaded natively) plus MAIN-CLAUDE.md at session start, CLAUDE.md plus SUBAGENT-CLAUDE.md at sub-agent start, one command per part to stay under the 10,000-character context cap. Before every Agent call, deny a route agent called with model, or without effort on the CLI (cli/sdk-cli). At session end, remove this session's session-env directory if it is empty, then sweep the empty session-env directories of sessions that are no longer running: strict-UUID names with no sessions/*.json record, not modified in the last 60 minutes. A directory that holds a file survives. The sweep is skipped when jq is absent, the sessions directory is missing, it holds no *.json records, or none of them yields a sessionId.
